description: Create the composable GuardrailChain system as a proper module under src/nexus/guardrails/. The existing src/nexus/governance/guardrails.py already has a basic implementation - this creates a more robust, modular version with Protocol-based design, async support, fail-closed behavior, and separate concerns (structural, policy, chain). The existing governance/guardrails.py should remain unchanged for backward compatibility.
steps: Create src/nexus/guardrails/__init__.py that exports GuardrailProtocol, GuardrailChain, GuardrailResult, StructuralGuardrail, PolicyGuardrail.

Create src/nexus/guardrails/protocol.py with: (a) GuardrailResult dataclass (passed: bool, violations: list[str], guardrail_name: str | None, metadata: dict), (b) GuardrailProtocol (runtime_checkable Protocol) with async methods: validate_input(input: Any, context: dict) -> GuardrailResult, validate_output(output: Any, context: dict) -> GuardrailResult, validate_tool_call(tool_name: str, args: dict, context: dict) -> GuardrailResult. Each method in the Protocol should have a name property.

Create src/nexus/guardrails/chain.py with GuardrailChain class. Methods: add(guardrail), remove(name), validate_input/validate_output/validate_tool_call that run all guardrails in sequence. Features: short-circuit on first failure (configurable via fail_fast=True), fail-closed (if a guardrail raises an exception, treat as failure), collect all violations when fail_fast=False. Return combined GuardrailResult.

Create src/nexus/guardrails/structural.py with StructuralGuardrail class implementing GuardrailProtocol. Checks: max_length, min_length, required_fields (for dict outputs), json_schema validation (basic type/required checking without external jsonschema lib), non-empty output validation.

Create src/nexus/guardrails/policy.py with PolicyGuardrail class implementing GuardrailProtocol. Checks: blocked_patterns (regex list for dangerous content), sensitive_paths (file paths that should not be accessed), dangerous_commands (shell commands that should be blocked), allowed_tools (whitelist of tool names for validate_tool_call).

Add tests in tests/test_guardrails.py covering: protocol conformance, chain short-circuit behavior, chain fail-closed on exception, structural guardrail validates lengths/fields, policy guardrail blocks patterns/paths/commands, tool call validation with allowed_tools whitelist.
acceptance_criteria: src/nexus/guardrails/ package exists with __init__.py, protocol.py, chain.py, structural.py, policy.py
GuardrailProtocol is runtime_checkable and both StructuralGuardrail and PolicyGuardrail satisfy it
GuardrailChain supports fail_fast and fail_closed modes
Running 'python -m pytest tests/test_guardrails.py -v' passes all new tests
Running 'python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q' still passes all existing tests
